input_fields.name: path
input_fields.description: Absolute path to one existing output file.

input_fields.name: expected_sha256
input_fields.description: Expected SHA-256 digest for that file.

result_fields.name: status
result_fields.description: passed when file hash equals expected_sha256, otherwise failed.

result_fields.name: geometry_verified
result_fields.description: Always false; file identity is not geometry verification.

procedure: Resolve the absolute path and reject symlink/reparse components before reading.
Read the file once, compute SHA-256 and size, and compare with expected_sha256.
Return the flat host result including geometry_verified=false.
Do not open the file in SpaceClaim or infer save/runtime success from existence.
rejection_rules: Reject relative paths, missing/nonregular files, reparse/symlink paths, or malformed digests.
Reject a hash mismatch as failed rather than substituting a new expected hash.
Do not claim geometry, native save, or execution evidence.
